mapper.sql: o.*, p.package_no, p.status AS package_status, p.ship_name, p.ship_country, s.name AS store_name, a.name AS account_name, a.provider, m.owh_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, (SELECT MAX(pr.product_name) FROM ecom_owh_product pr WHERE pr.account_id = o.account_id AND pr.product_code = o.product_code) AS product_name, (SELECT SUM(f.amount_base) FROM ecom_owh_fee f WHERE f.outbound_id = o.id) AS fee_base

FROM ecom_owh_outbound o JOIN ecom_package p ON p.id = o.package_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.id = o.mapping_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id

sql.if: AND (o.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.owh_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_package px WHERE px.id = o.package_id AND px.package_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_order eo ON eo.id = pi.order_id WHERE pi.package_id = o.package_id AND eo.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))

mapper.select:
SELECT o.status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_owh_outbound o
GROUP BY o.status

SELECT p.id, p.package_no, p.store_id, p.warehouse_id, p.channel_id, p.weight, p.shipping_cost, p.status, p.ship_name, p.ship_country, p.remark, p.create_time, p.update_time, s.name AS store_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, ch.name AS channel_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pi.order_id) FROM ecom_package_item pi WHERE pi.package_id = p.id) AS order_count, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN pi.part_main = 1 THEN pi.qty ELSE 0 END) FROM ecom_package_item pi WHERE pi.package_id = p.id) AS total_qty, (SELECT MAX(x.error_msg) FROM ecom_owh_outbound x WHERE x.package_id = p.id AND x.status = 'FAILED') AS error_msg FROM ecom_package p JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = p.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_logistics_channel ch ON ch.id = p.channel_id
ORDER BY p.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_package p JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id

SELECT p.id FROM ecom_package p JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = m.account_id WHERE p.status = 'WAIT_LABEL' AND m.status = 1 AND m.auto_push = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND a.auto_sync = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_owh_outbound x WHERE x.package_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ecom_owh_outbound WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.id FROM ecom_owh_outbound o JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = o.account_id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.auto_sync = 1 AND o.status IN #{s} ORDER BY o.id
SELECT DISTINCT pi.package_id AS "packageId", eo.platform_order_no AS "orderNo" FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_order eo ON eo.id = pi.order_id WHERE pi.package_id IN #{id}
